claims: In axially deformed nuclei, the magnetic dipole operator factorizes into collective core rotation and intrinsic nucleon projection: mu = g_R I + (g_K - g_R) K.
For K > 1/2 bands, the within-band reduced transition probability B(M1; I -> I-1) is proportional to (g_K - g_R)^2 K^2 (I^2 - K^2) / [I(2I+1)], providing a smooth spin dependence.

For K = 1/2 bands, Coriolis-induced coupling between Omega = +1/2 and -1/2 states introduces the magnetic decoupling parameter b, producing an odd-even staggering in B(M1) proportional to [1 + (-1)^(I+1/2) b]^2.

The in-band branching ratio B(M1; I -> I-1) / B(E2; I -> I-2) provides the experimental standard for inverting |g_K - g_R|/Q_0 directly from gamma-ray intensities and multipole mixing ratios delta(E2/M1).
Static magnetic moments mu(I) exhibit signature splitting in K=1/2 bands and approach the collective limit g_R I asymptotically as spin increases.
